title: Ommaviy nutq va debat
goal_uz: Dars oxirida siz auditoriya uchun aniq tuzilgan 3 daqiqalik nutq tayyorlab, ishonch bilan ayta olasiz, asosiy debat formatlarini ajratasiz va raqib dalilini to‘rt bosqichli usul bilan rad eta olasiz.

vocab.uz: nutq paytidagi qisqa savol yoki e’tiroz

scenes.title: Minbarga xush kelibsiz
board: Public Speaking and Debate
(Ommaviy nutq va debat)
Structure · Formats · Rebuttal · Delivery
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! Oldingi darsda mavzuni chuqur rivojlantirishni, ya’ni fikrni misol, sabab va oqibat bilan kengaytirishni mashq qildik. Bugun shu mahoratni minbarga olib chiqamiz. Dars oxirida siz aniq tuzilgan qisqa nutq tayyorlaysiz, debat formatlarini tanib olasiz, raqib dalilini ishonchli rad etasiz va ovozingiz, pauzangiz, nigohingiz bilan tinglovchini ushlab turasiz.
scenes.say: Today is about standing up and being heard: building a speech people can follow, arguing politely but ruthlessly, and delivering it all with genuine confidence.
scenes.say_uz: Bugun o‘rnimizdan turib, eshitilish haqida: odamlar kuzata oladigan nutq qurish, muloyim, lekin ayovsiz bahslashish va bularning barchasini chinakam ishonch bilan yetkazish.

scenes.title: Nutqning skeleti
board: Hook → Roadmap → Body (2–3 points) → Conclusion
Tell them what you’ll tell them, tell them,
then tell them what you told them.
(Nima deyishingizni ayting, ayting, takrorlang)
scenes.say_native: Yozma matnni o‘quvchi qayta o‘qiy oladi, tinglovchi esa yo‘q. Shuning uchun nutq inshodan ko‘ra aniqroq tuzilishi kerak. Klassik skelet to‘rt qismli: diqqatni tortadigan kirish, ya’ni hook; nutq xaritasi, ya’ni nimalar haqida gapirishingizni oldindan aytish; ikki-uch asosiy fikr; va xulosa bilan harakatga chaqiriq. Mashhur maslahat ham shuni aytadi: nima deyishingizni ayting, ayting, keyin nima deganingizni takrorlang.
scenes.say: A reader can flick back a page; a listener can’t. So grab attention, say where you’re going, take people there in two or three steps, and leave them knowing what to do.
scenes.say_uz: O‘quvchi sahifani orqaga varaqlay oladi, tinglovchi esa yo‘q. Shuning uchun diqqatni torting, qayerga ketayotganingizni ayting, odamlarni u yerga ikki-uch qadamda olib boring va nima qilishni bilgan holda qoldiring.

scenes.title: Kirish: hook turlari
board: Question: Raise your hand if…
Story: Three years ago, I…
Striking fact / Quotation
Bold claim: Everything you know about X is wrong.

examples.t: Three years ago, I stood on a stage like this and forgot every word.
examples.uz: Uch yil oldin men shunday sahnada turib, har bir so‘zni unutib qo‘ydim.

scenes.say_native: Birinchi o‘ttiz soniyada tinglovchi sizni tinglash-tinglamaslikni hal qiladi. To‘rt ishonchli hook bor: auditoriyaga savol, qisqa shaxsiy hikoya, kutilmagan fakt yoki iqtibos, faqat manbasini bilsangiz, va dadil da’vo. Bizda rasmiy nutq “Hurmatli rais, aziz mehmonlar” kabi uzun murojaat bilan boshlanadi. Ingliz auditoriyasida bitta qisqa minnatdorchilik yetarli, keyin darhol hookka o‘tiladi. Bu hurmatsizlik emas, tinglovchi vaqtini qadrlash.
scenes.say: Good morning, everyone. Raise your hand if you’ve ever regretted sending an email. Right. Today I want to talk about the most expensive habit at work: replying too fast.
scenes.say_uz: Hammaga xayrli tong. Qachondir yuborgan xatingizdan afsuslangan bo‘lsangiz, qo‘l ko‘taring. Shunday. Bugun ishdagi eng qimmat odat haqida gapirmoqchiman: juda tez javob berish.

scenes.title: Signposting iboralari
board: I’d like to make three points. (Uch fikr aytmoqchiman)
Let’s start with… / This brings me to…
Having looked at X, let’s turn to Y.
So where does that leave us?

examples.t: Having looked at the costs, let’s turn to the benefits.
examples.uz: Xarajatlarni ko‘rib chiqib, endi foydalarga o‘taylik.

scenes.say_native: Signposting — yo‘l chetidagi belgilar: tinglovchiga hozir qayerda ekanini va keyin qayerga borishini aytadi. Yozuvda buni xatboshi bilan ko‘rsatamiz, nutqda esa faqat so‘z bilan. “Having looked at the costs, let’s turn to the benefits” jumlasidagi “having looked” perfekt sifatdosh: bir harakat tugadi, endi boshqasiga o‘tamiz. O‘zbekchadagi “ko‘rib chiqib” shakliga juda o‘xshaydi, shuning uchun uni bemalol ishlating.
scenes.say: Let’s start with time. This brings me to my second point: money. And having looked at time and money, let’s turn to what really matters: trust.
scenes.say_uz: Vaqtdan boshlaylik. Bu meni ikkinchi fikrimga olib keladi: pul. Vaqt va pulni ko‘rib chiqib, haqiqatan muhim narsaga o‘taylik: ishonchga.

scenes.title: Ritorik usullar
board: Rule of three: fast, fair and free
Antithesis: not because…, but because…
Anaphora: We will… We will… We will…
Rhetorical question: So what does this cost us?

examples.t: We choose to go to the Moon… not because they are easy, but because they are hard.
examples.uz: Biz Oyga borishni tanlaymiz… oson bo‘lgani uchun emas, qiyin bo‘lgani uchun. (J. F. Kennedy, 1962)

scenes.say_native: Nutq quloq uchun yoziladi, shuning uchun ritm va takror zarur. Uchlik qoidasi: uchta so‘z yoki fikr qulog‘ga tugallangan eshitiladi. Antiteza: ikki qarama-qarshi fikrni yonma-yon qo‘yish, Kennedining Oy haqidagi nutqidagi kabi. Anafora: jumlalar boshida bir xil so‘zni takrorlash. Ritorik savol: javobini o‘zingiz beradigan savol. O‘zbek notiqligida ham takror kuchli, farqi shundaki, inglizcha zamonaviy nutqda ular qisqa va o‘lchovli ishlatiladi.
scenes.say: So what does this cost us? It costs us time, it costs us money, and above all, it costs us trust. We are here not because the problem is small, but because it is growing.
scenes.say_uz: Xo‘sh, bu bizga nimaga tushadi? Vaqtga, pulga va eng avvalo, ishonchga. Biz bu yerda muammo kichik bo‘lgani uchun emas, balki u o‘sib borayotgani uchun turibmiz.

scenes.title: Xulosa va chaqiriq
board: Signal the end: So, to bring this together…
Echo the hook (boshiga qayting)
Call to action: small, specific, doable
✗ That’s all. Thank you.
scenes.say_native: Xulosa — tinglovchi eslab qoladigan oxirgi narsa. Avval tugashni signal bering: “So, to bring this together”. Keyin boshidagi hookka qayting: email bilan boshlagan bo‘lsangiz, email bilan tugating, bu nutqni yopiq doiraga aylantiradi. Oxirida kichik, aniq va bajarsa bo‘ladigan harakatga chaqiring. “That’s all, thank you” bilan tugatish esa butun kuchni so‘ndiradi, chunki tinglovchida hech qanday vazifa qolmaydi.
scenes.say: So, to bring this together: tonight, before you hit send on anything that matters, wait ten minutes. That is all I ask.
scenes.say_uz: Xullas, hammasini jamlasak: bugun kechqurun muhim biror narsani yuborishdan oldin o‘n daqiqa kuting. Mening so‘raydiganim shu, xolos.

scenes.title: Uzr bilan boshlash
board: ✗ Sorry, my English is not so good…
✗ I didn’t have much time to prepare…
✓ Here’s a question I’ve been asking myself…
✓ Memorise your first two sentences.
scenes.say_native: Eng ko‘p uchraydigan xato — nutqni uzr bilan boshlash: “Kechirasiz, ingliz tilim unchalik yaxshi emas” yoki “Tayyorlanishga vaqtim bo‘lmadi”. Bu kamtarlikka o‘xshaydi, lekin tinglovchiga “meni jiddiy qabul qilmang” degan signal beradi. Siz C2 darajasida gapiryapsiz, bu uzr haqiqatga ham to‘g‘ri kelmaydi. Yechim: birinchi ikki jumlani yod oling. Hayajon eng kuchli paytda ular sizni olib chiqadi.
scenes.say: Never apologise your way onto the stage. Memorise your first two sentences, so that nerves have nothing to grab onto.
scenes.say_uz: Hech qachon sahnaga uzr so‘rab chiqmang. Birinchi ikki jumlangizni yod oling, toki hayajon ilashadigan hech narsa topolmasin.

scenes.title: Kirishni qayta yozing
board: Weak: Sorry, I’m not really ready. My topic is recycling.
Rewrite it with a question or a striking image.
Then add a one-line roadmap.
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Ekrandagi kirish zaif: uzr bilan boshlanadi va mavzuni quruq e’lon qiladi. Uni qayta yozing: savol yoki yorqin tasvir bilan boshlang, keyin bir jumlalik xarita qo‘shing, ya’ni qaysi ikki fikr haqida gapirishingizni ayting. Uzr ham, “my topic is” iborasi ham bo‘lmasin. Variantingizni ovoz chiqarib ayting.
scenes.say: Rewrite this weak opening: a hook, then a one-line roadmap. No apology allowed.
scenes.say_uz: Bu zaif kirishni qayta yozing: hook, keyin bir jumlalik xarita. Uzr so‘rash taqiqlanadi.

scenes.title: Namuna kirish
board: Hook: What happens to the bottle you threw away this morning?
Roadmap: I’ll look at where it goes, and then at what we can change.
✓ no apology · ✓ no ‘my topic is’
scenes.say_native: Namuna. Hook savol shaklida va tinglovchining o‘z hayotiga bog‘langan: bugun ertalab tashlagan shishangiz qayerga ketadi? Keyin xarita: avval u qayerga borishini, so‘ng nimani o‘zgartirishimiz mumkinligini ko‘rib chiqamiz. Mavzu nomi aytilmadi, lekin hamma uni darhol tushundi. Sizning variantingizda ham uzr yo‘qmi va xarita bormi, tekshiring.
scenes.say: What happens to the bottle you threw away this morning? I’ll look at where it goes, and then at what we can change.
scenes.say_uz: Bugun ertalab tashlagan shishangiz bilan nima bo‘ladi? Avval u qayerga ketishini, keyin nimani o‘zgartira olishimizni ko‘rib chiqaman.

scenes.title: Bo‘laklarni tartiblang
board: A) This brings me to my second point: cost.
B) So tonight, switch off one screen.
C) What did you look at first this morning?
D) I’ll talk about sleep and then cost.
E) Let’s start with sleep.
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Ekranda bitta nutqning besh bo‘lagi aralash berilgan. Ularni to‘g‘ri tartibga keltiring: hook, xarita, birinchi fikr, ikkinchi fikr va xulosa bilan chaqiriq. Har bo‘lakda qaysi signal so‘z yordam berayotganiga e’tibor bering. Keyin butun nutqni bir oqimda, o‘zingizga ovoz chiqarib ayting.
scenes.say: Put the five fragments in order, then say the whole mini speech aloud.
scenes.say_uz: Besh bo‘lakni tartibga keltiring, keyin butun kichik nutqni ovoz chiqarib ayting.

scenes.title: Javoblar: C, D, E, A, B
board: C → D → E → A → B
C = hook (question)
D = roadmap · E, A = body
B = call to action
scenes.say_native: To‘g‘ri tartib: C, D, E, A, B. C — savol shaklidagi hook. D — xarita: avval uyqu, keyin xarajat. E — “Let’s start with” birinchi fikrni ochadi. A — “This brings me to my second point” ikkinchisiga o‘tkazadi. B — “So tonight” xulosa va aniq chaqiriq. Ko‘rib turibsizki, signal so‘zlarning o‘zi tartibni deyarli aytib beradi. Tinglovchi uchun ham xuddi shunday ishlaydi.
scenes.say: What did you look at first this morning? I’ll talk about sleep and then cost. Let’s start with sleep… This brings me to my second point: cost… So tonight, switch off one screen.
scenes.say_uz: Bugun ertalab birinchi bo‘lib nimaga qaradingiz? Uyqu, keyin xarajat haqida gapiraman. Uyqudan boshlaylik… Bu meni ikkinchi fikrimga olib keladi: xarajat… Shuning uchun bugun kechqurun bitta ekranni o‘chiring.

scenes.title: Tinglash: qisqa nutq
board: Listening 1: a short talk to colleagues
Topic: the four-day working week
Listen for: hook, points, call to action
scenes.say_native: Endi qisqa nutq parchasini tinglang. Notiq hamkasblari oldida to‘rt kunlik ish haftasi haqida gapiradi. Uchta narsani kuzating: u qanday hook bilan boshlaydi, nechta asosiy fikr aytadi va oxirida tinglovchilardan aniq nima qilishni so‘raydi. Signposting iboralarini ham eshitishga harakat qiling, ular sizga tuzilmani topishda yordam beradi.
scenes.say: Imagine waking up on a Friday with nowhere to be. Not a holiday, just an ordinary Friday. I want to make two points about a four-day week. First, productivity: teams that have tried it often report getting the same work done in less time. This brings me to my second point: people. Rested staff stay longer, and replacing someone is never cheap. So here is my request: give us a three-month trial in one department, and judge us on the results.
scenes.say_uz: Juma kuni hech qayerga bormasligingizni bilib uyg‘onishni tasavvur qiling. Bayram emas, oddiy juma. To‘rt kunlik hafta haqida ikki fikr aytmoqchiman. Birinchisi, unumdorlik: buni sinab ko‘rgan jamoalar ko‘pincha xuddi shu ishni kamroq vaqtda bajarishlarini aytadi. Bu meni ikkinchi fikrimga olib keladi: odamlar. Dam olgan xodimlar uzoqroq qoladi, birovni almashtirish esa hech qachon arzon emas. Iltimosim: bitta bo‘limda uch oylik sinov bering va bizni natijaga qarab baholang.

scenes.title: Nutqni tahlil qiling
board: 1) What kind of hook does she use?
2) What are her two points?
3) What exactly does she ask for?
4) Which phrase moves her to point two?
scenes.say_native: To‘rt savolga javob bering. Notiq qanday hook ishlatdi? Uning ikki asosiy fikri nima? U oxirida aniq nimani so‘radi? Qaysi ibora uni ikkinchi fikrga o‘tkazdi? Javoblarni to‘liq inglizcha jumla bilan ayting, masalan: “She opens with a scenario”. Agar bitta javobni topa olmasangiz, nutqni xayolan qayta eshitib ko‘ring.
scenes.say: What kind of hook does she use? What are her two points? What exactly does she ask for? And which phrase moves her on?
scenes.say_uz: U qanday hook ishlatadi? Uning ikki fikri nima? U aniq nimani so‘raydi? Va qaysi ibora uni keyingi fikrga o‘tkazadi?

scenes.title: Javoblar: nutq tahlili
board: 1) Imagine… (a vivid scenario)
2) productivity · people
3) a three-month trial in one department
4) This brings me to my second point
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: u tasavvur qildiradigan hook bilan boshladi: “Imagine waking up on a Friday”. Ikkinchi: fikrlar unumdorlik va odamlar, ya’ni xodimlarni saqlab qolish. Uchinchi: bitta bo‘limda uch oylik sinov. Chaqiriq aniq va kichik, shuning uchun unga “ha” deyish oson. To‘rtinchi: “This brings me to my second point”. Notiq ehtiyotkor ham: “often report” deydi, “always” emas, ya’ni da’voni oshirib yubormaydi.
scenes.say: A scenario, two points, and one small, specific request. Notice the careful hedge: teams often report, not teams always achieve.
scenes.say_uz: Ssenariy, ikki fikr va bitta kichik, aniq iltimos. Ehtiyotkor cheklovga e’tibor bering: jamoalar ko‘pincha aytadi, jamoalar doim erishadi emas.

scenes.title: Debat: asosiy atamalar
board: Motion: This House believes that… / would…
Proposition (Government) vs Opposition
The Chair · the floor (auditoriya)
to propose / to oppose the motion

examples.t: This House would ban private cars from city centres.
examples.uz: Ushbu palata shahar markazlarida shaxsiy avtomobillarni taqiqlagan bo‘lardi.

scenes.say_native: Rasmiy debatda muhokama qilinadigan fikr “motion” deyiladi va odatda “This House believes that…” yoki “This House would…” bilan boshlanadi. “House” parlament an’anasidan qolgan, bu yerda “ushbu yig‘ilish” ma’nosida. Himoya qiluvchi tomon “proposition” yoki “government”, qarshi tomon “opposition”. Debatni “the Chair” boshqaradi. Muhimi, tomonni o‘zingiz tanlamaysiz, u sizga beriladi, shuning uchun shaxsiy fikringizga zid tomonni himoya qilish oddiy hol.
scenes.say: This House would ban private cars from city centres. I am proud to propose the motion. Our opponents will call it unrealistic. We will show you it is overdue.
scenes.say_uz: Ushbu palata shahar markazlarida shaxsiy avtomobillarni taqiqlagan bo‘lardi. Taklifni himoya qilishdan faxrlanaman. Raqiblarimiz buni amalga oshmaydigan deydi. Biz buning kechikkanini ko‘rsatamiz.

scenes.title: Debat formatlari
board: British Parliamentary: 4 teams × 2 speakers
World Schools: 2 teams × 3 speakers + reply speeches
Oxford-style: audience votes before & after
scenes.say_native: Uchta keng tarqalgan formatni biling. British Parliamentary: to‘rtta jamoa, har birida ikki notiq, ikkitasi taklif tarafida, ikkitasi qarshi; siz o‘z tarafingizdagi jamoa bilan ham raqobatlashasiz. World Schools: ikki jamoa, har birida uch notiq, oxirida qisqa xulosa nutqi, ya’ni reply speech bor. Oksford uslubida auditoriya debatdan oldin va keyin ovoz beradi, ko‘proq odamning fikrini o‘zgartirgan tomon yutadi. Har formatda nutq vaqti qat’iy belgilanadi.
scenes.say: In British Parliamentary, four teams of two compete at once, so you must beat the team on your own side too. In an Oxford-style debate, the side that changes more minds wins.
scenes.say_uz: British Parliamentary’da ikki kishilik to‘rt jamoa bir vaqtda bellashadi, shuning uchun o‘z tarafingizdagi jamoadan ham o‘tishingiz kerak. Oksford uslubidagi debatda ko‘proq fikrni o‘zgartirgan tomon yutadi.

scenes.title: Point of information
board: Rising: Point of information? / On that point!
Accept: Yes, briefly. / Go ahead.
Decline: Not at the moment, thank you.
BP: first and last minute protected
scenes.say_native: Parlament uslubidagi debatlarda raqib nutqingiz o‘rtasida turib, qisqa savol yoki e’tiroz berishni so‘rashi mumkin. Bu “point of information” deyiladi. British Parliamentary’da nutqning birinchi va oxirgi daqiqasi himoyalangan, bu vaqtda POI berilmaydi. Siz qabul qilishingiz yoki muloyim rad etishingiz mumkin. Yaxshi notiq odatda bir-ikkitasini qabul qiladi, chunki hammasini rad etish qo‘rqoqlikdek ko‘rinadi. Javob bering va darhol rejangizga qayting.
scenes.say: Point of information? Yes, briefly. Doesn’t a ban hurt small shops? Not at all, and I’ll come to that in a moment. As I was saying…
scenes.say_uz: Bir savol mumkinmi? Ha, qisqa. Taqiq kichik do‘konlarga zarar bermaydimi? Aslo yo‘q, va bunga birozdan keyin to‘xtalaman. Aytayotganimdek…

scenes.title: Grammatik tuzoqlar
board: ✗ I am agree with the motion.
✓ I agree with / We support the motion.
✗ Let’s discuss about this.
✓ Let’s discuss / debate this.
scenes.say_native: Ikki tipik xato. Birinchisi “I am agree”. O‘zbekchadagi “roziman” va ruschadagi “я согласен” sifatga o‘xshagani uchun “am” qo‘shiladi, lekin inglizcha “agree” fe’l: “I agree”. Ikkinchisi “discuss about”. Ruschadagi “обсуждать о” ta’sirida “about” qo‘shiladi, lekin “discuss” va “debate” to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri to‘ldiruvchi oladi. Ot shaklida esa “a discussion about” to‘g‘ri. C2 darajasida bunday xatolar ishonchingizni darhol kamaytiradi.
scenes.say: We agree. Let’s debate the motion, not debate about it. A discussion about it is fine; to discuss about it is not.
scenes.say_uz: Biz rozimiz. Keling, taklifni muhokama qilaylik, about’siz. A discussion about — ot shaklida to‘g‘ri; discuss fe’li bilan esa about ortiqcha.

scenes.title: Debat tilini to‘ldiring
board: 1) This House … that exams do more harm than good.
2) I’m proud to … the motion. (Proposition)
3) — Point of information? — Not at the moment, … .
4) Let’s discuss (about?) the issue.
scenes.say_native: To‘rt jumlani to‘ldiring. Birinchisi — debat mavzusining standart boshlanishi. Ikkinchisi — taklif tarafidagi notiq nima qiladi? Uchinchisi — POIni muloyim rad etish. To‘rtinchisi — “discuss” fe’li bilan to‘g‘ri jumla: “about” kerakmi yoki yo‘qmi? Javoblarni ovoz chiqarib, to‘liq jumla bilan ayting.
scenes.say: Complete the four sentences, and watch out for that little word about.
scenes.say_uz: To‘rtta jumlani to‘ldiring va o‘sha kichik about so‘zidan ehtiyot bo‘ling.

scenes.title: Javoblar: debat tili
board: 1) This House believes that…
2) I’m proud to propose the motion.
3) Not at the moment, thank you.
4) Let’s discuss the issue. (no about)
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: “This House believes that exams do more harm than good”. Ikkinchi: “propose the motion”; qarshi taraf esa “oppose the motion” deydi. Uchinchi: “Not at the moment, thank you” yoki “No, thank you”. To‘rtinchi: “Let’s discuss the issue”, hech qanday “about”siz. To‘rttasini ham topgan bo‘lsangiz, rasmiy debatning asosiy so‘z boyligini egallabsiz.
scenes.say: This House believes that exams do more harm than good. I’m proud to propose the motion. Not at the moment, thank you. Let’s discuss the issue.
scenes.say_uz: Ushbu palata imtihonlar foydadan ko‘ra ko‘proq zarar keltiradi, deb hisoblaydi. Taklifni himoya qilishdan faxrlanaman. Hozircha yo‘q, rahmat. Keling, masalani muhokama qilaylik.

scenes.title: Rebuttal: to‘rt bosqich
board: 1) They say… (summarise fairly)
2) But… (counter-claim)
3) Because… (reason / evidence)
4) Therefore… (why it matters)

examples.t: They say cars are essential for business. But most city-centre shoppers arrive on foot or by bus, because parking is already scarce. Therefore a ban costs shops far less than they fear.
examples.uz: Ular avtomobil biznes uchun zarur deydi. Lekin markazdagi xaridorlarning ko‘pi piyoda yoki avtobusda keladi, chunki to‘xtash joyi allaqachon kam. Demak, taqiq do‘konlarga ular qo‘rqqanchalik zarar keltirmaydi.

scenes.say_native: Raddiya, ya’ni rebuttal — debatning yuragi. Eng ishonchli shablon to‘rt bosqichli. Birinchi, raqib nima deganini adolatli qisqartirib aytasiz: “They say…”. Ikkinchi, qarshi da’voingiz: “But…”. Uchinchi, sabab yoki dalil: “because…”. To‘rtinchi, bu debat natijasi uchun nima uchun muhimligi: “therefore…”. Ko‘p notiqlar to‘rtinchi qadamni unutadi va raddiya havoda osilib qoladi. Xulosani hakamga o‘zingiz ayting.
scenes.say: They say, but, because, therefore. Summarise their point fairly, deny it, prove it, then tell the judges why it matters. The fourth step is the one most speakers forget.
scenes.say_uz: Ular aytadi, lekin, chunki, demak. Ularning fikrini adolatli qisqartiring, rad eting, isbotlang, keyin hakamlarga nima uchun muhimligini ayting. To‘rtinchi qadamni ko‘pchilik unutadi.

scenes.title: Raddiya strategiyalari
board: Challenge the evidence: Where is the data?
Challenge the logic: It doesn’t follow that…
Even if…, it still doesn’t matter because…
Turn it: That actually supports our side.
scenes.say_native: Dalilni to‘rt yo‘l bilan urish mumkin. Birinchi, dalilning o‘ziga: ma’lumot qayerda, namuna kichik emasmi? Ikkinchi, mantiqqa: A to‘g‘ri bo‘lsa ham, B undan kelib chiqmaydi. Uchinchi, “even if” usuli: raqib da’vosini vaqtincha qabul qilib, baribir uning muhim emasligini ko‘rsatasiz. Hakam qaysi variantga ishonmasin, siz yutasiz. To‘rtinchi, dalilni teskari aylantirish: raqibning misoli aslida sizning tarafingizni isbotlaydi.
scenes.say: Even if a ban hurts some shops in the short term, it doesn’t follow that we should reject it. In fact, our opponents’ own example, the market square, got busier once the cars were gone.
scenes.say_uz: Taqiq qisqa muddatda ayrim do‘konlarga zarar keltirsa ham, undan uni rad etishimiz kerak degan xulosa chiqmaydi. Aslida, raqiblarimizning o‘z misoli, bozor maydoni, mashinalar ketgach gavjumroq bo‘ldi.

scenes.title: C2 darajadagi raddiya iboralari
board: That argument rests on the assumption that…
This conflates X with Y. (aralashtiradi)
I’ll concede that…, but… (tan olaman, lekin)
The burden of proof lies with… (isbot yuki)

examples.t: I’ll concede that the scheme is expensive, but cost alone was never the question.
examples.uz: Loyiha qimmat ekanini tan olaman, lekin masala hech qachon faqat narxda bo‘lmagan.

scenes.say_native: C2 darajasida “you are wrong” o‘rniga aniqroq iboralar ishlatiladi. “That argument rests on the assumption that…” dalilning yashirin asosini ochadi. “This conflates X with Y” raqib ikki narsani aralashtirganini aytadi. “I’ll concede that…, but…” kichik nuqtada yon berib, katta nuqtada yutish usuli. Tan olish zaiflik emas, u sizni adolatli ko‘rsatadi. “The burden of proof lies with them” isbot majburiyati kimda ekanini eslatadi.
scenes.say: That argument rests on the assumption that everyone owns a car. It also conflates access with convenience. And the burden of proof lies with those who want nothing to change.
scenes.say_uz: Bu dalil hammaning mashinasi bor degan farazga tayanadi. U, shuningdek, yetib borish imkoniyatini qulaylik bilan aralashtiradi. Isbot yuki esa hech narsa o‘zgarmasligini istaganlar zimmasida.

scenes.title: Mantiqiy xatolarni nomlash
board: Straw man: attacking a weaker version
False dichotomy: only two options offered
Slippery slope: A → … → disaster
Ad hominem: attacking the person
scenes.say_native: Raqib mantiqiy xato qilsa, uni nomlash raddiyani tezlashtiradi. Straw man — fikringizni zaiflashtirib, o‘sha soxta versiyaga hujum qilish. False dichotomy — ko‘p variant bor, lekin faqat ikkitasi taklif qilinadi. Slippery slope — kichik qadam albatta falokatga olib keladi, degan isbotsiz zanjir. Ad hominem — dalilga emas, odamga hujum. Faqat atamani aytish yetmaydi, xato nimada ekanini bir jumlada tushuntiring.
scenes.say: My opponent says we want to ban all cars everywhere. That’s a straw man: our motion is about city centres. And cars or a dead economy is a false choice.
scenes.say_uz: Raqibim biz hamma joyda barcha mashinalarni taqiqlamoqchimiz, deydi. Bu somon odam: taklifimiz shahar markazlari haqida. Yo mashinalar, yo o‘lik iqtisodiyot esa soxta tanlov.

scenes.title: Shaxsga hujum va qo‘pollik
board: ✗ My opponent is too young to understand this.
✗ You are completely wrong!
✓ I’m afraid that doesn’t hold up, because…
✓ With respect, that misses…
scenes.say_native: Bizning madaniyatda yoshi katta odamga ochiq e’tiroz noqulay, ba’zan esa bahsda to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri “siz noto‘g‘risiz” deyish odatiy. Ingliz debatida ikkalasi ham boshqacha: e’tiroz hurmatsizlik emas, chunki u g‘oyaga qaratiladi, lekin u yumshatilgan shaklda aytiladi. “Raqibim juda yosh” degan gap ad hominem va ball yo‘qotadi. Raqibni rol nomi bilan ataysiz: “my opponent”, “the previous speaker”. Formula: ohangda yumshoq, mazmunda qattiq.
scenes.say: With respect, I’m afraid that doesn’t hold up. It’s a fair point about cost, but it misses the bigger picture.
scenes.say_uz: Hurmat bilan, afsuski, bu dalil o‘zini oqlamaydi. Narx haqida o‘rinli fikr, lekin u kattaroq manzarani e’tibordan chetda qoldiradi.

scenes.title: Raddiya tuzing
board: Motion: This House would abolish homework.
Opposition: Homework teaches discipline.
Rebut it: They say… But… Because… Therefore…
scenes.say_native: Endi o‘zingiz raddiya tuzing. Siz uy vazifasini bekor qilish tarafidasiz. Qarshi tomon “uy vazifasi intizomni o‘rgatadi” dedi. To‘rt bosqichdan foydalaning: ular nima dedi, siz nima deysiz, nima uchun va bu debat uchun nimani anglatadi. Xohlasangiz “even if” yoki “I’ll concede that” iborasini qo‘shing. Ovoz chiqarib, yigirma soniya ichida ayting.
scenes.say: The opposition says homework teaches discipline. You have twenty seconds. They say, but, because, therefore.
scenes.say_uz: Qarshi tomon uy vazifasi intizomni o‘rgatadi, deydi. Sizda yigirma soniya bor. Ular aytadi, lekin, chunki, demak.

scenes.title: Namuna raddiya
board: They say homework teaches discipline.
But discipline comes from routine, not worksheets,
because sport, music or chores build it too.
Therefore students lose nothing they need.
scenes.say_native: Namuna. Avval adolatli qisqartirish: ular uy vazifasi intizom beradi, deydi. Keyin qarshi da’vo: intizom varaqalardan emas, muntazam tartibdan keladi. Sabab: sport, musiqa va uy yumushlari ham intizom beradi. Xulosa: demak, taklifimiz o‘quvchilardan zarur hech narsani olmaydi. “Even if” qo‘shgan bo‘lsangiz, yanada yaxshi. Javobingizda to‘rtinchi qadam bormi, tekshiring.
scenes.say: They say homework teaches discipline. But discipline comes from routine, not worksheets, because sport, music and chores build it just as well. Therefore abolishing homework costs students nothing they truly need.
scenes.say_uz: Ular uy vazifasi intizomni o‘rgatadi, deydi. Lekin intizom varaqalardan emas, muntazam tartibdan keladi, chunki sport, musiqa va uy yumushlari ham uni shakllantiradi. Demak, uy vazifasini bekor qilish o‘quvchilardan haqiqatan zarur hech narsani olmaydi.

scenes.title: Xatoni nomlang
board: 1) Either we ban phones in schools, or children will never read again.
2) If we allow one late essay, soon nobody will meet any deadline.
3) Why listen to him? He failed his own exams.
scenes.say_native: Uchta gapni o‘qing va har biridagi mantiqiy xatoni nomlang: straw man, false dichotomy, slippery slope yoki ad hominem. Keyin har biriga bir jumlalik muloyim raddiya o‘ylab ko‘ring, masalan “That’s a false choice, because…”. Xato nomini aytish yetmaydi, sababini ham qo‘shing.
scenes.say: Name the fallacy in each sentence, then answer it in one polite sentence.
scenes.say_uz: Har bir gapdagi mantiqiy xatoni nomlang, keyin unga bir muloyim jumla bilan javob bering.

scenes.title: Javoblar: mantiqiy xatolar
board: 1) False dichotomy
2) Slippery slope
3) Ad hominem
✓ That’s a false choice: we could limit phones, not ban them.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchisi — false dichotomy: telefonni cheklash kabi boshqa yo‘llar ham bor. Ikkinchisi — slippery slope: bitta istisno albatta umumiy tartibsizlikka olib keladi, degan isbotsiz zanjir. Uchinchisi — ad hominem: odamning imtihon natijasi uning dalilini noto‘g‘ri qilmaydi. Raddiyada sabab qismi doim bo‘lsin.
scenes.say: That’s a false choice: we could limit phones rather than ban them. One exception is not a policy. And his exam results tell us nothing about his argument.
scenes.say_uz: Bu soxta tanlov: telefonlarni taqiqlash o‘rniga cheklashimiz mumkin. Bitta istisno siyosat emas. Uning imtihon natijalari esa dalili haqida hech narsa aytmaydi.

scenes.title: Tinglash: debatdan parcha
board: Listening 2: a debate exchange
Motion: This House would ban private cars from city centres.
Listen for: the POI, the concession, the rebuttal
scenes.say_native: Endi debatdan parchani tinglang. Qarshi tomon notiqi gapiryapti, taklif tomonidan esa kimdir point of information beradi. Uchta narsani kuzating: POI nima haqida, notiq unga qanday javob beradi va qaysi nuqtada yon beradi, ya’ni nimani tan oladi. Keyin uning asosiy raddiyasini va oxirida savolni qanday qayta qo‘yganini aniqlang.
scenes.say: Opposition: The proposition want to punish ordinary drivers… Proposition: Point of information? Opposition: Briefly. Proposition: Isn’t clean air good for everyone, drivers included? Opposition: Of course, and I’ll concede that pollution is real. But a ban is the bluntest possible tool. Cleaner buses and a congestion charge would cut pollution without shutting out elderly and disabled people who depend on cars. So the real question isn’t whether we want clean air, but how we get it fairly.
scenes.say_uz: Qarshi tomon: Taklif tomoni oddiy haydovchilarni jazolamoqchi… Taklif tomoni: Bir savol mumkinmi? Qarshi tomon: Qisqa. Taklif tomoni: Toza havo hamma uchun, jumladan haydovchilar uchun ham foydali emasmi? Qarshi tomon: Albatta, va ifloslanish haqiqat ekanini tan olaman. Lekin taqiq eng qo‘pol vosita. Tozaroq avtobuslar va tirbandlik to‘lovi mashinaga bog‘liq keksalar va nogironlarni chetga surmasdan ifloslanishni kamaytiradi. Demak, asl savol toza havoni xohlaymizmi-yo‘qmi emas, unga qanday adolatli erishamiz.

scenes.title: Debatni tushunish
board: 1) What is the POI about?
2) What does the speaker concede?
3) What two alternatives does she propose?
4) How does she reframe the question?
scenes.say_native: To‘rt savol. POI nima haqida edi? Notiq nimani tan oldi? U taqiq o‘rniga qanday ikki muqobil yo‘l taklif qildi? Va oxirida savolni qanday qayta shakllantirdi? Oxirgi savolga alohida e’tibor bering: “not whether…, but how…” tuzilmasi raddiyani chiroyli yakunlaydi, uni o‘z nutqingizda ham ishlating.
scenes.say: What is the point of information about? What does she concede? What are her two alternatives? And how does she reframe the question?
scenes.say_uz: Point of information nima haqida? U nimani tan oladi? Uning ikki muqobil yo‘li nima? Va savolni qanday qayta shakllantiradi?

scenes.title: Javoblar: debat parchasi
board: 1) clean air benefits drivers too
2) pollution is real
3) cleaner buses + a congestion charge
4) not whether…, but how… fairly
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. POI toza havo haydovchilarga ham foydali ekanini eslatdi. Notiq qisqa qabul qildi va ifloslanish haqiqat ekanini tan oldi, bu uni adolatli ko‘rsatdi. Keyin “but” bilan raddiyaga o‘tdi: taqiq — eng qo‘pol vosita. Muqobillar: tozaroq avtobuslar va tirbandlik to‘lovi. Oxirida savolni qayta qo‘ydi: masala toza havoni xohlash emas, unga adolatli erishish. Bu “even if” strategiyasining amaldagi namunasi.
scenes.say: She accepts the point, concedes that pollution is real, then turns: a ban is the bluntest tool. Finally she reframes the debate around fairness.
scenes.say_uz: U savolni qabul qiladi, ifloslanish haqiqat ekanini tan oladi, keyin burilish yasaydi: taqiq — eng qo‘pol vosita. Oxirida debatni adolat atrofida qayta shakllantiradi.

scenes.title: Ovoz: sur’at va pauza
board: Slow down: nerves speed you up
Pause BEFORE the key word
Pause AFTER a big claim
Thought groups: / short chunks /

examples.t: The answer / is not more rules. // It’s more trust.
examples.uz: Javob — ko‘proq qoida emas. Bu — ko‘proq ishonch.

scenes.say_native: Endi ishonchli yetkazishga o‘tamiz. Hayajonlangan odam tezlashadi, shuning uchun ataylab sekinlashing. Pauza — notiqning eng kuchli quroli. Asosiy so‘zdan oldingi pauza tinglovchini kutishga majbur qiladi, katta da’vodan keyingisi esa fikrni hazm qilishga vaqt beradi. Nutqni fikr guruhlariga bo‘ling: har guruh bir nafasda aytiladigan bitta ma’no birligi. Sizga uzun tuyulgan ikki soniya auditoriyaga tabiiy eshitiladi.
scenes.say: The answer is not more rules. It’s more trust. Did you feel that pause? Silence is not empty. It is the moment your audience starts to think.
scenes.say_uz: Javob — ko‘proq qoida emas. Bu — ko‘proq ishonch. Bu pauzani his qildingizmi? Sukunat bo‘sh emas. Bu auditoriyangiz o‘ylay boshlagan lahza.

scenes.title: Urg‘u va ohang
board: Contrast: We don’t need MORE money, we need BETTER spending.
Lists: rising ↗, rising ↗, falling ↘
Statements fall ↘ = conviction
✗ Rising ↗ on every statement = uncertainty
scenes.say_native: Qarama-qarshi urg‘u fikrni ochadi: “We don’t need MORE money, we need BETTER spending”. Ro‘yxatda oxirgisidan oldingi elementlar odatda ko‘tariluvchi, oxirgisi pasayuvchi ohang bilan aytiladi, bu “ro‘yxat tugadi” degan signal; uchlik qoidasi aynan shunday ishlaydi. Darak gap oxirida ohangni pasaytiring, bu ishonch belgisi. Har gap oxirida ohangni ko‘tarish esa o‘zingizdan so‘rayotgandek eshitiladi.
scenes.say: We don’t need more money, we need better spending. It saves time, it saves money, and it builds trust. Let your voice fall, and you sound like you mean it.
scenes.say_uz: Bizga ko‘proq pul emas, yaxshiroq sarflash kerak. Bu vaqtni tejaydi, pulni tejaydi va ishonch quradi. Ovozingiz pasaysin, shunda gapingizga ishonayotgandek eshitilasiz.

scenes.title: Tana tili va hayajon
board: Eye contact: one face, one thought
Stand still · open hands
Cue cards: key words, not sentences
Fillers (um, like, you know) → pause
scenes.say_native: Har bir fikrni zaldagi bitta odamga ayting, keyin boshqasiga o‘ting. Tik turing, qo‘llaringiz ochiq bo‘lsin. Bizda rasmiy yig‘ilishda matnni qog‘ozdan o‘qish odatiy, lekin ingliz auditoriyasi buni tayyorlanmaganlik deb biladi, shuning uchun kartochkaga faqat kalit so‘zlarni yozing. Hayajonda nafas chiqarishni uzunroq qiling va ovoz chiqarib, tik turib mashq qiling. “Um”, “like” o‘rniga pauza qiling: o‘zbekcha “anaqa” ham ingliz nutqingizga ko‘chmasin.
scenes.say: One face, one thought. Key words on your cards, never full sentences. And when you feel an um coming, close your mouth and pause instead.
scenes.say_uz: Bitta yuz, bitta fikr. Kartochkalarda faqat kalit so‘zlar, hech qachon to‘liq jumlalar emas. Um aytmoqchi bo‘lganingizni sezsangiz, og‘zingizni yuming va pauza qiling.

scenes.title: Yetkazishdagi xatolar
board: ✗ speeding up when nervous
✗ statements ending ↗ like questions
✗ reading every word from paper
✓ slow · falling tone · cue cards · pauses
scenes.say_native: Uchta tipik muammo. Birinchi, hayajonda tezlashib ketish: tinglovchi ortda qoladi. Ikkinchi, har bir darak gap oxirida ohangni ko‘tarish: siz o‘z fikringizdan so‘rayotgandek ko‘rinasiz. Uchinchi, qog‘ozdan so‘zma-so‘z o‘qish: ko‘z bilan aloqa yo‘qoladi, ovoz esa bir xil bo‘lib qoladi. Bu odatlarni o‘zingiz sezmaysiz, shuning uchun nutqingizni yozib oling va tinglab ko‘ring.
scenes.say: Slow down, let your statements fall, and look up from the page. These three habits alone will make you far more convincing.
scenes.say_uz: Sekinlashing, darak gaplaringiz oxirida ohang pasaysin va qog‘ozdan boshingizni ko‘taring. Faqat shu uch odat sizni ancha ishonchliroq qiladi.

scenes.title: Pauza va urg‘uni belgilang
board: we don’t need more cars in the centre we need more space for people
and that space will make the city cleaner safer and fairer
scenes.say_native: Ekrandagi ikki jumlada tinish belgilari yo‘q. Daftaringizga ko‘chiring, pauzalarni chiziqcha bilan belgilang, qarama-qarshi urg‘u tushadigan so‘zlarni toping va uchta sifatdan iborat ro‘yxat ohangini belgilang. Keyin sekin, to‘la zalga gapirayotgandek ovoz chiqarib ayting.
scenes.say: Mark the pauses, find the contrasting words, and decide how the list of three should rise and fall. Then say it slowly.
scenes.say_uz: Pauzalarni belgilang, qarama-qarshi so‘zlarni toping va uchtalik ro‘yxat qanday ko‘tarilib-tushishini hal qiling. Keyin sekin ayting.

scenes.title: Javoblar: nutq xaritasi
board: We don’t need more CARS in the centre / we need more space for PEOPLE. //
And that space / will make the city cleaner ↗ / safer ↗ / and fairer ↘ //
scenes.say_native: Javob. Birinchi jumlada “centre” dan keyin pauza bor, qarama-qarshi urg‘u esa “cars” va “people” so‘zlariga tushadi. Ikkinchi jumlada “space” dan keyin qisqa pauza, so‘ng ro‘yxat: “cleaner” va “safer” ko‘tariluvchi, “fairer” pasayuvchi ohang bilan. Oxirgi so‘zdan keyin uzunroq pauza qiling va zalga qarang. Variantingiz biroz boshqacha bo‘lsa ham, mantiqi shu bo‘lsa, yaxshi.
scenes.say: We don’t need more cars in the centre. We need more space for people. And that space will make the city cleaner, safer, and fairer.
scenes.say_uz: Bizga markazda ko‘proq mashina kerak emas. Bizga odamlar uchun ko‘proq joy kerak. Va o‘sha joy shaharni tozaroq, xavfsizroq va adolatliroq qiladi.

scenes.title: Yakuniy topshiriq: bir daqiqalik nutq
board: Motion: This House believes social media does more harm than good.
Hook → 2 points → rebut 1 counter-argument → call to action
This brings me to… / They say… But… / So tonight…
scenes.say_native: Yakuniy topshiriq. Siz taklif tarafidasiz: ijtimoiy tarmoqlar foydadan ko‘ra ko‘proq zarar keltiradi. Bir daqiqalik nutq rejasini tuzing: hook, ikki asosiy fikr, raqibning bitta dalilini to‘rt bosqichda rad etish va aniq chaqiriq. Avval yigirma soniya reja tuzing, keyin taymerni yoqib, tik turib, ovoz chiqarib ayting. Pauza va pasayuvchi ohangni unutmang.
scenes.say: Your turn. Propose the motion: social media does more harm than good. Plan for twenty seconds, then stand up and speak for one minute.
scenes.say_uz: Navbat sizda. Taklifni himoya qiling: ijtimoiy tarmoqlar foydadan ko‘ra ko‘proq zarar keltiradi. Yigirma soniya reja tuzing, keyin turib, bir daqiqa gapiring.

scenes.title: Namuna nutq
board: Hook: How many times have you checked your phone today?
Points: attention · comparison
Rebuttal: They say it connects us. But…
Call: Delete one app for a week.
scenes.say_native: Namuna nutqni tinglang va o‘zingiznikini solishtiring. Hook — savol. Ikki fikr — diqqat va o‘zini boshqalar bilan solishtirish. Raddiya — “ular bizni bog‘laydi deydi, lekin…” va sabab. Chaqiriq — bir hafta bitta ilovani o‘chirish. Tekshiring: signal iboralar bormi, raddiyada “therefore” qadami bormi, chaqiriq aniq va kichikmi?
scenes.say: How many times have you checked your phone today? Social media drains two things: our attention and our self-worth. They say it connects us. But constant comparison isolates us, because we see everyone’s highlights and nobody’s ordinary days. Therefore the cost outweighs the benefit. So here is my challenge: delete one app for a week, and notice what you get back.
scenes.say_uz: Bugun telefoningizni necha marta tekshirdingiz? Ijtimoiy tarmoqlar ikki narsani so‘rib oladi: diqqatimizni va o‘zimizni qadrlashimizni. Ular bizni bog‘laydi, deyishadi. Lekin doimiy solishtirish bizni yolg‘izlatadi, chunki hammaning eng yorqin lahzalarini ko‘ramiz, hech kimning oddiy kunini emas. Demak, zarar foydadan ustun. Chaqirig‘im: bir hafta bitta ilovani o‘chiring va nimaga qaytib ega bo‘lganingizni kuzating.

scenes.title: Dars xulosasi
board: Structure: hook → roadmap → points → call to action
Formats: BP · World Schools · Oxford-style
Rebuttal: They say · But · Because · Therefore
Delivery: pace · pause · falling tone · eye contact
scenes.say_native: Xulosa qilamiz. Birinchi: nutq quloq uchun quriladi, hook, xarita, ikki-uch fikr va aniq chaqiriq bilan. Ikkinchi: debat formatlari turlicha, lekin hammasida motion, ikki taraf va qat’iy vaqt bor. Uchinchi: raddiya to‘rt bosqichda, “even if” va yon berish bilan kuchayadi, shaxsga hujum esa yo‘q. To‘rtinchi: ishonch sekin sur’at, pauza, pasayuvchi ohang va ko‘z bilan aloqadan tug‘iladi.
scenes.say: Build for the ear, argue with the idea, concede the small point to win the big one, and let silence do some of the work.
scenes.say_uz: Quloq uchun quring, g‘oya bilan bahslashing, kattasini yutish uchun kichik nuqtada yon bering va ishning bir qismini sukunatga topshiring.

scenes.title: Uy vazifasi
board: Homework: a 3-minute speech + rebut one argument
Success: hook, 2–3 signposted points, call to action
+ one full They say / But / Because / Therefore
Record it: no more than 3 fillers
scenes.say_native: Uy vazifasi: o‘zingiz tanlagan mavzuda uch daqiqalik nutq tayyorlang va unda bitta qarshi dalilni rad eting. Nutqni tik turib aytib, yozib oling. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: hook bor, ikki-uchta fikr signal iboralar bilan ajratilgan, raddiya to‘rt bosqichning hammasini o‘z ichiga oladi, nutq aniq chaqiriq bilan tugaydi va yozuvda uchtadan ortiq “um” yo‘q. Keyingi darsda tarjima va ikki tilli fikrlashni o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say: Your homework: a three-minute speech with one full rebuttal. Record it, count your fillers, and keep going until there are three or fewer.
scenes.say_uz: Uy vazifangiz: bitta to‘liq raddiyaga ega uch daqiqalik nutq. Uni yozib oling, to‘ldiruvchi so‘zlarni sanang va ular uchta yoki undan kam bo‘lguncha davom eting.

homework_uz: O‘zingiz tanlagan mavzuda uch daqiqalik nutq tayyorlang va unda raqibning bitta dalilini rad eting. Nutqni tik turib aytib, yozib oling. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: hook, signal iboralar bilan ajratilgan 2–3 fikr, “They say – But – Because – Therefore” shaklidagi to‘liq raddiya, aniq harakatga chaqiriq va yozuvda uchtadan ko‘p bo‘lmagan to‘ldiruvchi so‘z.

quiz.q: What is the main purpose of a roadmap at the start of a speech?
options: to tell the audience what points are coming
to thank every guest by name
quiz.why_uz: Xarita tinglovchiga qaysi fikrlar kelishini oldindan aytadi, chunki u matnni orqaga varaqlay olmaydi.

options: I am agree with the motion.
I agreed to the motion yesterday's.

quiz.q: In British Parliamentary debate, how many teams compete in one round?
quiz.why_uz: BP formatida har birida ikki notiqdan iborat to‘rtta jamoa bellashadi.

quiz.q: How is the winner decided in an Oxford-style debate?
options: by the side that changes more minds between two audience votes
by the number of points of information
quiz.why_uz: Auditoriya oldin va keyin ovoz beradi; ko‘proq fikrni o‘zgartirgan tomon yutadi.

quiz.q: Which is the best polite way to decline a point of information?
options: Not at the moment, thank you.
quiz.why_uz: “Not at the moment, thank you” — muloyim va standart rad etish.

quiz.q: What is missing from this rebuttal: 'They say exams are fair. But they reward memory.'
quiz.why_uz: Sabab (because) va natija (therefore) qadamlari yo‘q, shuning uchun raddiya to‘liq emas.

quiz.q: 'Either we cut taxes or the economy collapses.' This is an example of:
quiz.why_uz: Faqat ikki variant taklif qilinadi, aslida ular ko‘p: bu false dichotomy.

quiz.q: In a list of three, the usual intonation pattern is:
quiz.why_uz: Oxirgisidan oldingi elementlar ko‘tariluvchi, oxirgisi pasayuvchi ohang bilan aytiladi.

quiz.q: What should you do instead of saying 'um' while speaking?
quiz.why_uz: Qisqa pauza ongli va ishonchli eshitiladi, “um” esa adashgandek.
